cat-png.label: Root cat PNG style trial
cat-png.specification:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one square vocabulary picture for a Japanese listening game
Style/medium: match the supplied Kikimashta cat PNG's polished cartoon illustration language. Smooth rounded substantial forms, clean bold deep-violet contours, restrained soft tonal shading inside forms and gentle dimensional color. Warm golden-yellow/amber, rich violet/lavender and soft pink accents. Softer, calmer rendering than a glossy clip-art sticker. No bright white shine streaks, exclamation-shaped glare, photographic texture, watercolor or sketch strokes.
Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Study the cat's contour treatment, gentle shading, color relationships and simple forms. Do not reproduce the cat, headphones, paws, logo, lettering, Mount Fuji, torii, blossoms, sound marks, enclosing card or footer.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent outer background with an alpha channel. No painted white backdrop, checkerboard, lavender or cream tint, colored vignette, decorative scene or frame. Preserve opaque white subject details. A sky scene may contain blue sky and clouds within its intended silhouette, but no ground or horizon strip.
Composition/framing: one clear centered primary subject or the minimal action scene required by the word, full silhouette visible, about 65–75 percent of square canvas, generous margin. Readable at 145px.
Color: use the reference's warm golden and violet family for decorative accents. Preserve the factual/teaching color of the subject, including yellow banana, blue paint, green shoots and white clouds.
Constraints: correct anatomy, recognizable literal vocabulary subject, no answer labels, words, letters, branding, watermark, frame or decorative extras. Match the visual style rather than copying the cat's subject or background.
cat-png.approvalNote: All batch 02 cards approved; continue the cat-reference shading with white backgrounds into batch 03.
